M AMRITA 

Business Analyst | BFSI DOMAIN |Capital & Wealth Markets | Trade Lifecycle|

​ 9019087992 ​ amritamukhergee@gmail.com ​ https://www.linkedin.com/in/amrita-mukherjee-9b0285399/ ​ Bangalore

SUMMARY

I am a forward-thinking Business Analyst with over 5 years of experience in banking, real estate, and wealth management. My expertise lies in stakeholder alignment, solution design, and agile project management, leading cross-functional teams in global settings. I have successfully driven digital transformations, delivering impactful solutions and value to clients in capital markets and consulting

EXPERIENCE

Senior Business Analyst

IndusInd Bank

	02/2024 - 02/2025 	Bangalore

A major private sector bank in India

Writing UAT, User Stories, Working on Sprint Planning, interacting with internal and external stakeholders

Engage client to gather software requirements/ business role and ensure alignment with development teams

Draft and maintain business requirements and align them with functional and technical requirements

Preparing and analyzing system use cases/ BRDs

Familiar with creating Use case Diagram, Activity Diagram and Balsamiq Wireframes

Complete Knowledge of SDLC & Software development Process

Business Analyst

Standard Chartered Bank

	01/2022 - 01/2024 	Bengaluru

A leading international bank offering a range of financial services

Managed end-to-end requirements gathering and solution delivery for financial institutions in capital markets and wealth management, including FX and interest rate products.

Collaborating with Clients and stakeholders while keeping them informed of progress and issues

Reviewing required performance reports on daily, weekly, and monthly schedules to external and internal teams

Managing Scope to avoid scope creep and ensuring agreed scope is delivered

Working with developers to clarify required enhancements

Conducted JAD with industry experts to document business process functionality

Functional testing of the system to ensure alignment with client requirements

Business Analyst

Housing.com

	11/2019 - 12/2021 	Gurgaon

A real estate listing platform in India

Created BRDs, solution documentation, requirement traceability matrices RTM , and test scenarios.

Performed functional testing to validate system functionality and product effectiveness.

Provided training to new joiners to improve process understanding and operational efficiency.

Identified and resolved impediments during daily Agile sprint meetings.

Deputy Sales Manager

Quikr

	11/2017 - 01/2019 	Kolkata

An online classifieds platform in India

Led client acquisition and seller onboarding through cross-functional coordination, delivering daily MIS reports, consistently meeting targets, and driving client retention.

Sales Executive

Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Limited

	07/2015 - 03/2017 	Kolkata

A leading player in the vacation ownership and leisure resort sector

Identified new business opportunities and maintained strong client relationships to deliver high-quality customer service.

www.enhancv.com

SKILLS

Agile	UAT	Waterfall	JIRA

Microsoft Project	Microsoft Power BI

Tableau	Visio	Lucid Chart	Confluence

KYC/AML	SQL	Balsamiq	Wireframes

SDLC	Functional Testing	GAP Analysis 

Stakeholder Management

USER Acceptance Testing	User stories	BRD

PROJECTS

Capital Markets Trading Platform Revamp

Capital Markets Trading Platform Revamp

Collaborated with global stakeholders on FX and IR product lifecycle upgrades

Defined business and functional requirements, supported UAT

Mapped end-to-end trade flows across front, middle, and back-office teams

Wealth Management Digital Onboarding

Wealth Management Digital Onboarding

Led requirement gathering and process redesign for client onboarding

Worked with technology teams to develop a scalable, compliant digital solution

Achieved a 25% reduction in account opening time

Real Estate Marketplace Integration

Real Estate Marketplace Integration

Analyzed user journeys and data flow for a regional property platform

Streamlined vendor onboarding workflows and reduced operational friction

Implemented automated documentation and API integrations

EDUCATION

MBA in Marketing and Finance

WBUT

01/2013 - 05/2015 

B. Sc. in Comp. Sc

Calcutta University

01/2010 - 05/2013
